headline: Labour Ministry: 'All pensioners will see increases, some larger and some smaller'
summary: Labour Minister Marinos Mousiouttas said that under the pension reform all pensioners will see increases, some larger and some smaller, depending on individual circumstances.
why: Pension reforms change public spending and household income, which affects fiscal planning and domestic consumption.

original_headline: Υπ. Εργασίας: «Αυξήσεις θα δουν όλοι οι συνταξιούχοι, άλλοι πιο μεγάλες και άλλοι λιγότερες»
